entries.title: Work that closes without your click leaves you a note
entries.body: When your first mate merges, drops or stops a task a crewmate worked on, and you did not click to do it, a note now says what became of the work in your first mate's own sentence, with the pull request linked after a merge. A crewmate whose work merges on its own shows you its full story before the merge. Each note stays until you close it, and Activity's line for a drop now says why.

picture.alt: A note titled with a task's key and dropped, in the first mate's sentence, beside Activity's Dropped line for the same task
